title: Monsoon Damage in Coastal Properties: What to Inspect
description: Heavy rain and salt air damage Pondicherry houses in predictable ways. What to inspect before and after each monsoon to avoid costly repairs.
h1: Monsoon damage in coastal properties: what to inspect before and after
lead: Rain and salt air work on a building all year. The monsoon is when hidden problems show.
wa: Hi, I read your guide and have a question about my property in Pondicherry

bullets: Roof and terrace: cracks, waterproofing, drains clear
Gutters and downpipes free of leaves
Trees with branches near the roof or wires
Electrical points near walls that get damp
Damp patches on ceilings and wall bases

paras: Near the coast, metal fittings rust faster and paint peels sooner. Repainting and re-sealing on a schedule is cheaper than repair.

A visit before and after the monsoon, with dated photos, is a sensible minimum. See the [monthly checklist](/guides/vacant-house-maintenance-pondicherry) and our [free property check](/free-rental-audit).
